speaker: A1NOHVLPYWB0TP
text: Hi there! I am looking for donations for the Save the children's Foundation? Could I interest you in that?

speaker: A16KMPWYUZO0M6
text: I would perhaps be interested can you tell me more a bout it

speaker: A1NOHVLPYWB0TP
text: It is a charity that helps hungry children in need. It is a international, non governmental organization that promotes children's rights, provides releif and support children in developing countries.

speaker: A16KMPWYUZO0M6
text: That sounds great, What countries do they help children in?

speaker: A1NOHVLPYWB0TP
text: There's quite a few! It's international. Even the smallest donation would make a difference to a child in need.

speaker: A16KMPWYUZO0M6
text: Ok I would like to see if I can help. I love children.

speaker: A1NOHVLPYWB0TP
text: That's great! They are the future you know... alot of the children are in war zones and facing daily threats of violence.

speaker: A16KMPWYUZO0M6
text: Of course nothing gets me more angry then seeing a child warrior soldier. Will we also be helping children soliders?

speaker: A1NOHVLPYWB0TP
text: There are no children soliders, only children that need help in some way with food, resources, emergency response, etc. This program has saves a great deal of lives. It has brought families together and gave hope to a new life.

speaker: A16KMPWYUZO0M6
text: Ok thats great. Do they need clothes as well?

speaker: A1NOHVLPYWB0TP
text: Yes! Alot of the proceeds go towards garments, shoes, and other things for the children. Some of them are basically naked and have nothing. Others have no shoes. It's really sad, but that's why there are programs out here like us to step in and provide help.

speaker: A16KMPWYUZO0M6
text: Ok well I know it is important for them to have basic needs. I hope the money donated goes directly to them and not in the pockets of those running the organization. Are you certain that the money will be used the right way?

speaker: A1NOHVLPYWB0TP
text: 86.5% of it goes towards support program services. And it is also tax deductible

speaker: A16KMPWYUZO0M6
text: That sounds like a good percentage and Im glad it will give me a tax break as well. How do you receive payments? credit card? cash?

speaker: A1NOHVLPYWB0TP
text: You can donate stock or mutual funds, you can mail it in to a designated address, you can make a payment online with a debit or credit card, PayPal is also an option, there are a ton of ways to get it done!

speaker: A16KMPWYUZO0M6
text: Wow that is a lot of options. What would you say is the amount of a the common donation that  someone like myself would donate. I am ready to donate today and would like to know an acceptable donation.

speaker: A1NOHVLPYWB0TP
text: Anything is acceptable! Whatever you feel comfortable! Just keep in mind that the children out here need you! I would suggest $20 a month if you can! If not, whatever you can spare.

speaker: A16KMPWYUZO0M6
text: Ok I would like to donate the $20 a month but I would like to hook it up to a credit card that is automatically deducted

speaker: A1NOHVLPYWB0TP
text: That's totally fine! Please visit us at  URL to read more and make your first donation!

speaker: A16KMPWYUZO0M6
text: Ok, thank you so much for your help. You have made this a good learning experience and I feel confident in my donation to Save The Children.
